after.note: Rebasing and Git Database publication change commit metadata, not the verified runtime tree.

measurementContract.ordinaryScope: Serial frames/edits phases on clean before/after source with existing native/glyph probes and no SDF method counter, retaining text batching off/on controls. Times under the later sdfUpdates.result count-only pass are not ordinary timing results.
measurementContract.freshSceneCounterScope: Two edit samples plus one warmup after fresh configuration; counts include all three real edit frames and only instanced SDF. Before and after diagnostic scripts instrument the same real methods/buffers.
measurementContract.postTimingCounterScope: The updated ordinary benchmark also runs sdfUpdates after timing/glyph assertions. The scene already has the first edit color: Core skips those unchanged setters, hence 8 packed rows vs ECS 12 for its conservative component notifications. This differs from the fresh-scene counter (12 on both).
measurementContract.limits: One before/after software WebGL cohort; no confidence interval, physical GPU timing or retained-heap measurement. Operation counts establish avoided work, not a stable frame-speed multiplier.

diagnosticSource.reproduction: Place these in .test-results/sdf-rows.probe.spec.ts and sdf-rows.probe.config.ts. Replace the absolute /@fs checkout prefix with the current checkout path. Run Playwright with that config and SDF_ROWS_PROBE_OUTPUT, on before and after runtime sources. The committed browser row tests and updated ordinary benchmark provide portable after controls.
